name: Cisco FMC MCP Server
description: A read-only Model Context Protocol server that enables LLMs to query Cisco Firepower Management Center (FMC) for firewall configurations, network objects, and deployment status. It features automatic token management and built-in rate limiting to safely interact with FMC 7.4.x instances through natural language.
